NeurIPS 2022 · INVERSE PROBLEMS / DIFFUSION PRIOR

去噪扩散恢复模型：用预训练扩散模型求线性逆问题的后验

Denoising Diffusion Restoration Models

Bahjat Kawar · Michael Elad · Stefano Ermon · Jiaming Song

线性逆问题（超分、去模糊、修补、上色）想要的是后验样本，但监督法只在单一退化下有效，无监督迭代法又慢。这篇论文把扩散模型的变分推理搬到「测量所在的谱空间」里：对前向算子做 SVD，在奇异值方向上按噪声大小决定「相信测量」还是「相信先验」，于是同一个预训练扩散模型不重训就能解任意线性逆问题，20 步（20 次网络前向）即可出结果。

读之前，先把这条链路分清

这一段是译者注，不是原文。它只做一件事：让你在读到公式 (1)–(8) 时，知道每个量在做什么，以及为什么 DDRM 要在「谱空间」里做扩散。

  1. 前向算子与前向问题：测量写成 y=Hx+zy = H x + zy=Hx+z，HHH 已知（超分的块平均、去模糊的卷积、修补的选择、上色的通道平均都是线性的），zzz 是已知方差的高斯噪声。求解的目标不是「一个最优解」，而是从后验 pθ(x∣y)p_\theta(x\mid y)pθ​(x∣y) 里采样。
  2. 为什么要 SVD：把 H=UΣV⊤H = U\Sigma V^\topH=UΣV⊤ 代入，整个问题在 VVV 的坐标系里解耦成 nnn 个独立的标量问题，第 iii 个方向上有两个量可直接比较：测量在该方向上的噪声 σy/si\sigma_y/s_iσy​/si​，和扩散模型此刻的噪声 σt\sigma_tσt​。谁大，就说明该方向上谁更不可信。
  3. 三种处理方式：奇异值为 0 的方向测量完全没有信息，照常做无条件生成；σt<σy/si\sigma_t < \sigma_y/s_iσt​<σy​/si​ 时测量比扩散噪声更干净，就直接把 yˉ(i)\bar{y}^{(i)}yˉ​(i) 当锚点；σt≥σy/si\sigma_t \ge \sigma_y/s_iσt​≥σy​/si​ 时测量更脏，就把测量与模型预测做凸组合，权重 ηb\eta_bηb​ 自动随噪声比变化。
  4. 为什么能不重训：定理 3.2 说明在 η=1\eta=1η=1、ηb=2σt2/(σt2+σy2/si2)\eta_b = 2\sigma_t^2/(\sigma_t^2+\sigma_y^2/s_i^2)ηb​=2σt2​/(σt2​+σy2​/si2​) 时，DDRM 的 ELBO 逐项等于一个去噪自编码器（即 DDPM/DDIM）目标，所以现成的无条件模型就是 DDRM 的近似最优解。
  5. 成本在哪里：NFE（网络前向次数）= 时间步数，DDRM 用 20 步；内存瓶颈是存 VVV（Θ(n2)\Theta(n^2)Θ(n2)），附录 D 用 Kronecker 结构把它降到 Θ(n)\Theta(n)Θ(n)。
术语速查（译者注）
后验采样 posterior sampling
从 pθ(x∣y)p_\theta(x\mid y)pθ​(x∣y) 抽样本，而不是求单个 MAP 解；同一输入可以给出多个都合理的重建。
前向算子 forward operator
本文一律指线性退化矩阵 HHH（含可能的加性高斯噪声 zzz）。
谱空间 spectral space
把信号写成 xˉ=V⊤x\bar{x}=V^\top xxˉ=V⊤x 后的坐标系，也就是 HHH 的右奇异向量张成的空间；在这个坐标里 HHH 是对角的。
VE / VP
Variance Exploding（xt=x0+σtϵx_t=x_0+\sigma_t\epsilonxt​=x0​+σt​ϵ，方差随 t 增大）与 Variance Preserving（DDPM 的 αt\sqrt{\alpha_t}αt​​ 参数化）。本文用 VE 表述，附录 B 证明两者只差一个固定线性变换。
NFE
neural function evaluations，网络前向次数，作为与硬件无关的运行时代理。
η / ηb
两个控制「每步注入多少噪声」的超参；η\etaη 管无关方向的随机性，ηb\eta_bηb​ 管测量与预测的混合比例。实验取 η=0.85\eta=0.85η=0.85、ηb=1\eta_b=1ηb​=1。
KID / FID / SSIM
KID 与 FID 衡量生成分布与真实分布的差距（越小越好）；SSIM 衡量结构相似度（越大越好）；PSNR 衡量像素保真（越大越好）。
三句话版本（译者注）

① 把逆问题的扩散过程搬到 HHH 的 SVD 坐标系里，让「测量噪声」和「扩散噪声」逐维可比；② 在这个坐标系里写出一个带 yyy 的条件变分分布 qqq 与模型分布 pθp_\thetapθ​，并证明 qqq 的边缘仍是 N(x0,σt2I)\mathcal{N}(x_0,\sigma_t^2 I)N(x0​,σt2​I)；③ 证明 pθp_\thetapθ​ 的 ELBO 与无条件 DDPM 目标同形，于是任意预训练模型都能直接拿来用。

摘要

English original
Abstract

图像恢复中许多有趣的任务都可以写成线性逆问题。求解这类问题的一类近期方法使用随机算法，从「给定测量时自然图像的后验分布」中采样。然而，高效的解往往需要针对具体问题做监督训练来建模后验；而不针对具体问题的无监督方法，通常依赖低效的迭代过程。本文通过引入去噪扩散恢复模型（Denoising Diffusion Restoration Models, DDRM）来解决这些问题：一种高效、无监督的后验采样方法。受变分推断启发，DDRM 利用一个预训练的去噪扩散生成模型来求解任意线性逆问题。我们在多个图像数据集上展示了 DDRM 的多面性，涵盖不同测量噪声量下的超分辨率、去模糊、图像修补与上色。在内容多样的 ImageNet 数据集上，DDRM 在重建质量、感知质量和运行时间上均优于当前领先的无监督方法，比最接近的竞品快 5×5\times5×。对于处在所观测 ImageNet 训练集分布之外的自然图像，DDRM 同样泛化良好。[1]

English original
Many interesting tasks in image restoration can be cast as linear inverse problems. A recent family of approaches for solving these problems uses stochastic algorithms that sample from the posterior distribution of natural images given the measurements. However, efficient solutions often require problem-specific supervised training to model the posterior, whereas unsupervised methods that are not problem-specific typically rely on inefficient iterative methods. This work addresses these issues by introducing Denoising Diffusion Restoration Models (DDRM), an efficient, unsupervised posterior sampling method. Motivated by variational inference, DDRM takes advantage of a pre-trained denoising diffusion generative model for solving any linear inverse problem. We demonstrate DDRM's versatility on several image datasets for super-resolution, deblurring, inpainting, and colorization under various amounts of measurement noise. DDRM outperforms the current leading unsupervised methods on the diverse ImageNet dataset in reconstruction quality, perceptual quality, and runtime, being 5×5\times5× faster than the nearest competitor. DDRM also generalizes well for natural images out of the distribution of the observed ImageNet training set.[1]

1 引言

English original
1 Introduction

图像处理中的许多问题——包括超分辨率 [31, 17]、去模糊 [28, 48]、图像修补 [55]、上色 [29, 58] 和压缩感知 [1]——都是线性逆问题的实例：其目标是在给定一个已知线性退化模型、可能含噪的测量下恢复图像。对某个特定的退化模型，图像恢复可以通过用「原图—退化图」成对数据端到端地监督训练神经网络来解决 [14, 58, 41]。但医学影像之类的真实应用往往要求能灵活应对多个、甚至无穷多个退化模型 [46]。此时，基于学习到的先验的无监督方法 [36] 可能更可取：退化模型只在推理时被知晓和使用，因而无需重新训练就能适应给定问题 [51]。通过学得关于图像内在结构的合理假设（例如先验、近端算子或去噪器），无监督方法无需在特定退化模型上训练，也能取得有效的恢复效果 [51, 40]。

English original
Many problems in image processing, including super-resolution [31, 17], deblurring [28, 48], inpainting [55], colorization [29, 58], and compressive sensing [1], are instances of linear inverse problems, where the goal is to recover an image from potentially noisy measurements given through a known linear degradation model. For a specific degradation model, image restoration can be addressed through end-to-end supervised training of neural networks, using pairs of original and degraded images [14, 58, 41]. However, real-world applications such as medical imaging often require flexibility to cope with multiple, possibly infinite, degradation models [46]. Here, unsupervised approaches based on learned priors [36], where the degradation model is only known and used during inference, may be more desirable since they can adapt to the given problem without re-training [51]. By learning sound assumptions over the underlying structure of images (e.g., priors, proximal operators or denoisers), unsupervised approaches can achieve effective restoration without training on specific degradation models [51, 40].

在这一无监督设定下，基于深度神经网络的先验已在多种图像恢复任务上展现出令人印象深刻的经验结果 [40, 50, 43, 38, 15]。为恢复信号，多数现有方法从神经网络取得一个与信号有关的先验项（例如自然图像的分布），从退化模型取得一个似然项，把两者组合成信号的后验，于是逆问题可以被表述为求解一个优化问题（例如最大后验 [8, 40]）或求解一个采样问题（例如后验采样 [2, 3, 25]）。随后这些问题常以迭代方法求解，例如梯度下降或 Langevin 动力学，这类方法计算量大，且对超参数调节敏感。[30] 中有一个极端的例子：该算法的一个「快速」版本需要 15,00015{,}00015,000 次神经网络函数求值（NFE）。

English original
Under this unsupervised setting, priors based on deep neural networks have demonstrated impressive empirical results in various image restoration tasks [40, 50, 43, 38, 15]. To recover the signal, most existing methods obtain a prior-related term over the signal from a neural network (e.g., the distribution of natural images), and a likelihood term from the degradation model. They combine the two terms to form a posterior over the signal, and the inverse problem can be posed as solving an optimization problem (e.g., maximum a posteriori [8, 40]) or solving a sampling problem (e.g., posterior sampling [2, 3, 25]). Then, these problems are often solved with iterative methods, such as gradient descent or Langevin dynamics, which may be demanding in computation and sensitive to hyperparameter tuning. An extreme example is found in [30] where a “fast” version of the algorithm uses 15,00015{,}00015,000 neural function evaluations (NFEs).

受这条无监督研究路线启发，我们提出一种高效方法，名为去噪扩散恢复模型（DDRM），它只需要低至 202020 次 NFE 就能取得有竞争力的结果。DDRM 是一个去噪扩散生成模型 [44, 19, 45]，它以测量与该逆问题为条件，逐步、随机地把一个样本去噪成期望的输出。这样，我们为学习当前逆问题的后验分布引入了一个变分推断目标。随后我们证明它与无条件去噪扩散生成模型的目标等价 [19]，这使得我们可以把这类模型部署到 DDRM 中、用于各种线性逆问题（见图 2）。据我们所知，DDRM 是第一个通用的、基于采样的逆问题求解器，能够为一般内容的图像高效地产生一系列高质量、多样、同时有效的解。

English original
Inspired by this unsupervised line of work, we introduce an efficient approach named Denoising Diffusion Restoration Models (DDRM), that can achieve competitive results in as low as 202020 NFEs. DDRM is a denoising diffusion generative model [44, 19, 45] that gradually and stochastically denoises a sample to the desired output, conditioned on the measurements and the inverse problem. This way we introduce a variational inference objective for learning the posterior distribution of the inverse problem at hand. We then show its equivalence to the objective of an unconditional denoising diffusion generative model [19], which enables us to deploy such models in DDRM for various linear inverse problems (see Figure 2). To our best knowledge, DDRM is the first general sampling-based inverse problem solver that can efficiently produce a range of high-quality, diverse, yet valid solutions for general content images.

我们通过与多种基于学习先验的竞争方法对比，来展示 DDRM 的经验有效性，例如深度生成先验（DGP）[38]、SNIPS [25] 和去噪正则化（RED）[40]。在 ImageNet 示例上，以 PSNR 与 KID [5] 衡量，DDRM 在无噪超分辨率与去模糊下大多优于这些神经网络基线；而当它位列第二时，在 NFE 上至少高效 50×50\times50×。当测量中包含噪声时，我们的优势更大，因为迭代方法产生的噪声伪影在本方法中不会出现。在各类真实图像上，我们进一步展示了 DDRM 在超分辨率、去模糊、修补与上色上的结果（见图 1）。一个在 ImageNet 上训练的 DDRM 也能处理位于其训练集分布之外的图像（见图 6）。

English original
We demonstrate the empirical effectiveness of DDRM by comparing with various competitive methods based on learned priors, such as Deep Generative Prior (DGP) [38], SNIPS [25], and Regularization by Denoising (RED) [40]. On ImageNet examples, DDRM mostly outperforms the neural network baselines under noiseless super-resolution and deblurring measured in PSNR and KID [5], and is at least 50×50\times50× more efficient in terms of NFEs when it is second-best. Our advantage becomes even larger when measurement noise is involved, as noisy artifacts produced by iterative methods do not appear in our case. Over various real-world images, we further show DDRM results on super-resolution, deblurring, inpainting and colorization (see Figure 1). A DDRM trained on ImageNet also works on images that are out of its training set distribution (see Figure 6).

English original
2 Background

线性逆问题

English original
Linear Inverse Problems.

一个一般的线性逆问题表述为

English original
A general linear inverse problem is posed as
公式 (1)
y=Hx+z,\mathbf{y} = \mathbf{H}\mathbf{x} + \mathbf{z},y=Hx+z,
y = Hx + z

其中我们要从测量 y∈Rmy \in \mathbb{R}^{m}y∈Rm 恢复信号 x∈Rnx \in \mathbb{R}^{n}x∈Rn；H∈Rm×nH \in \mathbb{R}^{m\times n}H∈Rm×n 是已知的线性退化矩阵；z∼N(0,σy2I)z \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma_y^2 I)z∼N(0,σy2​I) 是方差已知的独立同分布加性高斯噪声。xxx 的内在结构可以用一个生成模型表示，记为 pθ(x)p_\theta(x)pθ​(x)。给定 yyy 与 HHH，信号上的后验可写成 pθ(x∣y)∝pθ(x) p(y∣x)p_\theta(x\mid y) \propto p_\theta(x)\,p(y\mid x)pθ​(x∣y)∝pθ​(x)p(y∣x)，其中「似然」项 p(y∣x)p(y\mid x)p(y∣x) 由公式 (1)定义；这种做法利用了一个学得的先验 pθ(x)p_\theta(x)pθ​(x)，我们按 [36] 的术语称之为「无监督」方法，因为该先验并不一定依赖该逆问题。恢复 xxx 可以通过从这个后验中采样完成 [2]，但这可能需要很多次迭代才能产生一个好的样本。或者也可以通过学习来近似这个后验：用摊销推断（即监督学习）训练一个模型，该模型学习在给定 yyy 时预测 xxx，而 yyy 由 xxx 与某个特定的 HHH 生成。这种做法可能比基于采样的方法更高效，但对那些没有训练过的逆问题可能泛化很差。

English original
where we aim to recover the signal x∈Rnx \in \mathbb{R}^{n}x∈Rn from measurements y∈Rmy \in \mathbb{R}^{m}y∈Rm, where H∈Rm×nH \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times n}H∈Rm×n is a known linear degradation matrix, and z∼N(0,σy2I)z \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma_y^2 I)z∼N(0,σy2​I) is an i.i.d. additive Gaussian noise with known variance. The underlying structure of xxx can be represented via a generative model, denoted as pθ(x)p_\theta(x)pθ​(x). Given yyy and HHH, a posterior over the signal can be posed as: pθ(x∣y)∝pθ(x)p(y∣x)p_\theta(x \mid y) \propto p_\theta(x) p(y \mid x)pθ​(x∣y)∝pθ​(x)p(y∣x), where the “likelihood” term p(y∣x)p(y \mid x)p(y∣x) is defined via Equation (1); such an approach leverages a learned prior pθ(x)p_\theta(x)pθ​(x), and we call it an “unsupervised” approach based on the terminology in [36], as the prior does not necessarily depend on the inverse problem. Recovering xxx can be done by sampling from this posterior [2], which may require many iterations to produce a good sample. Alternatively, one can also approximate this posterior by learning a model via amortized inference (i.e., supervised learning); the model learns to predict xxx given yyy, generated from xxx and a specific HHH. While this can be more efficient than sampling-based methods, it may generalize poorly to inverse problems that have not been trained on.

去噪扩散概率模型

English original
Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models.

生成模型学到的结构已被应用于各种逆问题，并且常常优于与数据无关的结构约束（例如稀疏性）[7]。这类生成模型从样本中学习一个模型分布 pθ(x)p_\theta(x)pθ​(x) 来近似数据分布 q(x)q(x)q(x)。特别地，扩散模型在图像上的无条件生成建模表现令人印象深刻 [13]。扩散模型是具有马尔可夫链结构 xT→xT−1→…→x1→x0x_T \to x_{T-1} \to \ldots \to x_1 \to x_0xT​→xT−1​→…→x1​→x0​（其中 xt∈Rnx_t \in \mathbb{R}^nxt​∈Rn）的生成模型，其联合分布为

English original
Structures learned by generative models have been applied to various inverse problems and often outperform data-independent structural constraints such as sparsity [7]. These generative models learn a model distribution pθ(x)p_\theta(x)pθ​(x) that approximates a data distribution q(x)q(x)q(x) from samples. In particular, diffusion models have demonstrated impressive unconditional generative modeling performance on images [13]. Diffusion models are generative models with a Markov chain structure xT→xT−1→…→x1→x0x_T \to x_{T-1} \to \ldots \to x_1 \to x_0xT​→xT−1​→…→x1​→x0​ (where xt∈Rnx_t \in \mathbb{R}^nxt​∈Rn), which has the following joint distribution:

pθ(x0:T)=pθ(T)(xT)∏t=0T−1pθ(t)(xt∣xt+1).p_\theta(x_{0:T}) = p_\theta^{(T)}(x_T) \prod_{t=0}^{T-1} p_\theta^{(t)}(x_t \mid x_{t+1}).pθ​(x0:T​)=pθ(T)​(xT​)∏t=0T−1​pθ(t)​(xt​∣xt+1​). 抽出 x0:Tx_{0:T}x0:T​ 之后，只保留 x0x_0x0​ 作为生成模型的样本。为训练扩散模型，引入一个固定的、因子化的变分推断分布：

English original

After drawing x0:Tx_{0:T}x0:T​, only x0x_0x0​ is kept as the sample of the generative model. To train a diffusion model, a fixed, factorized variational inference distribution is introduced:

3 去噪扩散恢复模型

English original
3 Denoising Diffusion Restoration Models

基于后验采样的逆问题求解器常常面临一个两难：无监督方法适用于一般问题但效率低，而监督方法效率高却只能处理特定问题。为了化解这个两难，我们提出去噪扩散恢复模型（DDRM）：一个面向一般线性逆问题的无监督求解器，能够在测量含噪或不含噪的情况下处理这类任务。DDRM 效率高，并且与流行的无监督求解器 [40, 38, 25] 相比具有竞争力的性能。

English original
Inverse problem solvers based on posterior sampling often face a dilemma: unsupervised approaches apply to general problems but are inefficient, whereas supervised ones are efficient but can only address specific problems. To solve this dilemma, we introduce Denoising Diffusion Restoration Models (DDRM), an unsupervised solver for general linear inverse problems, capable of handling such tasks with or without noise in the measurements. DDRM is efficient and exhibits competitive performance compared to popular unsupervised solvers [40, 38, 25].

DDRM 背后的关键想法是：找到一个既无监督、又契合监督学习目标的解。首先，我们针对一个具体逆问题描述 DDRM 的变分目标（3.1 节）。接着，我们介绍适合线性逆问题的 DDRM 具体形式，它允许直接使用预训练的无条件模型与类条件模型（3.2 节、3.3 节）。最后，我们讨论在计算与内存上都高效的实用算法（3.4 节、3.5 节）。

English original
The key idea behind DDRM is to find an unsupervised solution that also suits supervised learning objectives. First, we describe the variational objective for DDRM over a specific inverse problem (Section 3.1). Next, we introduce specific forms of DDRM that are suitable for linear inverse problems and allow pre-trained unconditional and class-conditional diffusion models to be used directly (Sections 3.2, 3.3). Finally, we discuss practical algorithms that are compute and memory efficient (Sections 3.4, 3.5).

English original

3.2 为图像恢复设计的扩散过程

English original
3.2 A Diffusion Process for Image Restoration

与 SNIPS [25] 类似，我们考虑 HHH 的奇异值分解（SVD），并在它的谱空间中执行扩散。这样做的想法是把测量 yyy 中的噪声与 x1:Tx_{1:T}x1:T​ 中的扩散噪声绑定在一起，确保扩散结果 x0x_0x0​ 忠实于测量。借助 SVD，我们可以识别出 yyy 中缺失的那部分 xxx 数据，并用扩散过程将其合成出来；与此相伴，yyy 中含噪的数据经历一个去噪过程。例如在含噪修补中（H=diag([1,…,1,0,…,0])H = \mathrm{diag}([1,\ldots,1,0,\ldots,0])H=diag([1,…,1,0,…,0])、σy≥0\sigma_y \ge 0σy​≥0），谱空间就是像素空间，因此模型应当生成缺失的像素，并对 yyy 中已观测的像素去噪。

English original
Similar to SNIPS [25], we consider the singular value decomposition (SVD) of HHH, and perform the diffusion in its spectral space. The idea behind this is to tie the noise present in the measurements yyy with the diffusion noise in x1:Tx_{1:T}x1:T​, ensuring that the diffusion result x0x_0x0​ is faithful to the measurements. By using the SVD, we identify the data from xxx that is missing in yyy, and synthesize it using a diffusion process. In conjunction, the noisy data in yyy undergoes a denoising process. For example, in inpainting with noise (e.g., H=diag([1,…,1,0,…,0])H = \mathrm{diag}([1, \ldots, 1, 0, \ldots, 0])H=diag([1,…,1,0,…,0]), σy≥0\sigma_y \geq 0σy​≥0), the spectral space is simply the pixel space, so the model should generate the missing pixels and denoise the observed ones in yyy.

直观地说，我们的构造对谱空间的每个下标分别考虑不同的情形。(i) 若对应的奇异值为零，则 yyy 不直接为该下标提供任何信息，其更新与常规的无条件生成类似。(ii) 若奇异值非零，更新会考虑 yyy 提供的信息，这又取决于测量在谱空间中的噪声水平（σy/si\sigma_y/s_iσy​/si​）是否大于扩散模型的噪声水平（σt\sigma_tσt​）；为使命题 3.1 成立，谱空间中的测量 yˉ(i)\bar{y}^{(i)}yˉ​(i) 在这两种情形下会被以不同方式缩放。

Similar to DDPM, we aim to obtain predictions of x0x_0x0​ at every step ttt; and to simplify notations, we use the symbol xθ,tx_{\theta, t}xθ,t​ to represent this prediction made by a model fθ(xt+1,t+1):Rn×R→Rnf_\theta(x_{t+1}, t+1): \mathbb{R}^{n} \times \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}^{n}fθ​(xt+1​,t+1):Rn×R→Rn that takes in the sample xt+1x_{t+1}xt+1​ and the conditioned time step (t+1)(t+1)(t+1).[5] We also define xˉθ,t(i)\bar{x}_{\theta, t}^{(i)}xˉθ,t(i)​ as the iii-th index of xˉθ,t=V⊤xθ,t\bar{x}_{\theta, t} = V^\top x_{\theta, t}xˉθ,t​=V⊤xθ,t​.

3.3「学习」图像恢复模型

English original
3.3 “Learning” Image Restoration Models

在通过选择 σ1:T\sigma_{1:T}σ1:T​、η\etaη 与 ηb\eta_bηb​ 定义好 pθ(t)p_\theta^{(t)}pθ(t)​ 与 q(t)q^{(t)}q(t) 之后，我们就可以通过最大化由此得到的 ELBO 目标（附录 A）来学习模型参数 θ\thetaθ。然而这种做法并不理想，因为对每个逆问题（给定 HHH 与 σy\sigma_yσy​）都要学一个不同的模型，对任意逆问题来说不够灵活。幸运的是，情况不必如此。在下面的定理中我们说明：在先前工作 [19, 45] 所用的合理假设下，DDPM / DDIM 的最优解同时也是某个 DDRM 问题的最优解。

English original
Once we have defined pθ(t)p_\theta^{(t)}pθ(t)​ and q(t)q^{(t)}q(t) by choosing σ1:T\sigma_{1:T}σ1:T​, η\etaη and ηb\eta_bηb​, we can learn model parameters θ\thetaθ by maximizing the resulting ELBO objective (in Appendix A). However, this approach is not desirable since we have to learn a different model for each inverse problem (given HHH and σy\sigma_yσy​), which is not flexible enough for arbitrary inverse problems. Fortunately, this does not have to be the case. In the following statement, we show that an optimal solution to DDPM / DDIM can also be an optimal solution to a DDRM problem, under reasonable assumptions used in prior work [19, 45].

定理 3.2. 假设对任意 t≠t′t\ne t't=t′，模型 fθ(t)f_\theta^{(t)}fθ(t)​ 与 fθ(t′)f_\theta^{(t')}fθ(t′)​ 不共享权重；那么当 η=1\eta=1η=1 且 ηb=2σt2σt2+σy2/si2\eta_b = \dfrac{2\sigma_t^2}{\sigma_t^2+\sigma_y^2/s_i^2}ηb​=σt2​+σy2​/si2​2σt2​​ 时，DDRM 的 ELBO 目标（细节见附录 A）可以改写为公式 (2)中 DDPM / DDIM 目标的形式。证明见附录 C。

English original
Theorem 3.2. Assume that the models fθ(t)f_\theta^{(t)}fθ(t)​ and fθ(t′)f_\theta^{(t')}fθ(t′)​ do not have weight sharing whenever t≠t′t \neq t't=t′, then when η=1\eta = 1η=1 and ηb=2σt2/(σt2+σy2/si2)\eta_b = 2\sigma_t^2/(\sigma_t^2 + \sigma_y^2/s_i^2)ηb​=2σt2​/(σt2​+σy2​/si2​), the ELBO objective of DDRM (details in Appendix A) can be rewritten in the form of the DDPM / DDIM objective in Equation (2). We place the proof in Appendix C.

即使对 η\etaη 与 ηb\eta_bηb​ 取不同的值，证明也显示 DDRM 目标是谱空间中的加权平方和误差，因此预训练的 DDPM 模型是其最优解的良好近似。于是，我们可以用公式 (7)与公式 (8)的更新，把同一个扩散模型（不针对逆问题做条件化）应用到各种线性逆问题上，只改变 HHH 及其 SVD（UUU、Σ\SigmaΣ、VVV）。

English original
Even for different choices of η\etaη and ηb\eta_bηb​, the proof shows that the DDRM objective is a weighted sum-of-squares error in the spectral space, and thus pre-trained DDPM models are good approximations to the optimal solution. Therefore, we can apply the same diffusion model (unconditioned on the inverse problem) using the updates in Equation (7) and Equation (8) and only modify HHH and its SVD (UUU, Σ\SigmaΣ, VVV) for various linear inverse problems.

3.4 DDRM 的加速算法

English original
3.4 Accelerated Algorithms for DDRM

典型的扩散模型用很多时间步（例如 1000）训练，以达到最优的无条件图像合成质量，但采样速度慢，因为需要大量 NFE。先前工作 [45, 13] 通过配合恰当的更新规则「跳过」一些步来加速这一过程。这对 DDRM 同样成立，因为对任意递增的 σ1:T\sigma_{1:T}σ1:T​ 选择，我们都能得到公式 (2)中的去噪自编码器目标。对于一个有 T′T'T′ 个时间步的预训练扩散模型，我们可以取 σ1:T\sigma_{1:T}σ1:T​ 为训练所用 T′T'T′ 个步的一个子集。

English original
Typical diffusion models are trained with many timesteps (e.g., 1000) to achieve optimal unconditional image synthesis quality, but sampling speed is slow as many NFEs are required. Previous works [45, 13] have accelerated this process by “skipping” steps with appropriate update rules. This is also true for DDRM, since we can obtain the denoising autoencoder objective in Equation (2) for any choice of increasing σ1:T\sigma_{1:T}σ1:T​. For a pre-trained diffusion model with T′T'T′ timesteps, we can choose σ1:T\sigma_{1:T}σ1:T​ to be a subset of the T′T'T′ steps used in training.

3.5 省内存的 SVD

English original
3.5 Memory Efficient SVD

我们的方法与 SNIPS [25] 类似，都利用退化算子 HHH 的 SVD。对大小为 nnn 的信号，存储矩阵 VVV 的空间复杂度为 Θ(n2)\Theta(n^2)Θ(n2)，这在本算法以及 Plug and Play（PnP）[51] 等其他方法中都构成内存瓶颈。通过利用所用矩阵 HHH 的特殊性质，我们可以把去噪、修补、超分辨率、去模糊与上色的这一复杂度降到 Θ(n)\Theta(n)Θ(n)（细节见附录 D）。

English original
Our method, similar to SNIPS [25], utilizes the SVD of the degradation operator HHH. This constitutes a memory consumption bottleneck in both algorithms as well as other methods such as Plug and Play (PnP) [51], as storing the matrix VVV has a space complexity of Θ(n2)\Theta(n^2)Θ(n2) for signals of size nnn. By leveraging special properties of the matrices HHH used, we can reduce this complexity to Θ(n)\Theta(n)Θ(n) for denoising, inpainting, super resolution, deblurring, and colorization (details in Appendix D).

4 相关工作

English original
4 Related Work

针对不同设定下的逆问题，已有多种深度学习解法被提出（详细综述见 [37]）。我们关注无监督设定：训练时可以访问一个干净图像数据集，但退化模型只在推理时被知晓。这一设定天然适用于所有线性逆问题，而这正是医学影像 [46, 20] 等许多真实应用所期望的性质。

English original
Various deep learning solutions have been suggested for solving inverse problems under different settings (see a detailed survey in [37]). We focus on the unsupervised setting, where we have access to a dataset of clean images at training time, but the degradation model is known only at inference time. This setup is inherently general to all linear inverse problems, a property desired in many real-world applications such as medical imaging [46, 20].

几乎所有无监督逆问题求解器都在一个迭代框架中使用训练好的神经网络。PnP、RED 及其后继工作 [51, 40, 32, 49] 把去噪器作为最速下降、不动点迭代或交替方向乘子法（ADMM）等迭代优化算法的一部分。OneNet [39] 训练了一个网络来直接学习 ADMM 的近端算子。[34, 16, 30] 则提出在不同迭代算法中类似地使用去噪器。[43] 的作者利用了借助额外类别标签学到的鲁棒分类器。

English original
Almost all unsupervised inverse problem solvers utilize a trained neural network in an iterative scheme. PnP, RED, and their successors [51, 40, 32, 49] apply a denoiser as part of an iterative optimization algorithm such as steepest descent, fixed-point, or alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM). OneNet [39] trained a network to directly learn the proximal operator of ADMM. A similar use of denoisers in different iterative algorithms is proposed in [34, 16, 30]. The authors of [43] leverages robust classifiers learned with additional class labels.

另一条路线是在生成模型的隐空间中搜索一张生成图像，使其退化后尽可能接近给定测量。这类方法已被提出多个版本，主要集中于生成对抗网络（GAN）[7, 11, 33]。虽然它们在特定类别的图像（尤其是人脸）上取得了令人印象深刻的结果，但在 ImageNet [12] 这类更多样的数据集上并未被证明普遍成功。深度生成先验（DGP）通过同时优化隐输入与 GAN 生成器的权重缓解了这一问题 [38]。

English original
Another approach is to search the latent space of a generative model for a generated image that, when degraded, is as close as possible to the given measurements. Multiple such methods were suggested, mainly focusing on generative adversarial networks (GANs) [7, 11, 33]. While they exhibit impressive results on images of a specific class, most notably face images, these methods are not shown to be largely successful under a more diverse dataset such as ImageNet [12]. Deep Generative Prior (DGP) mitigates this issue by optimizing the latent input as well as the weights of the GAN's generator [38].

更近期地，去噪扩散模型被用于在有监督（即训练时已知退化模型）[42, 41, 13, 10, 54] 与无监督 [22, 26, 25, 21, 46, 47, 9] 两种设定下求解逆问题。与先前方法不同，多数基于扩散的方法能够从含噪显著的测量中成功恢复图像。然而这些方法非常慢，往往需要数百到数千次迭代，并且尚未在多样化的数据集上得到验证。我们的方法受变分推断启发，得到与具体问题相关的非平衡更新规则，从而在少得多的迭代次数下给出高质量的解。

English original
More recently, denoising diffusion models were used to solve inverse problems in both supervised (i.e., degradation model is known during training) [42, 41, 13, 10, 54] and unsupervised settings [22, 26, 25, 21, 46, 47, 9]. Unlike previous approaches, most diffusion-based methods can successfully recover images from measurements with significant noise. However, these methods are very slow, often requiring hundreds or thousands of iterations, and are yet to be proven on diverse datasets. Our method, motivated by variational inference, obtains problem-specific, non-equilibrium update rules that lead to high-quality solutions in much fewer iterations.

ILVR [9] 提出了一种基于扩散的方法来处理无噪超分辨率，可在 250250250 步内运行。在附录 H 中我们证明：当应用于同一个底层生成扩散模型时，ILVR 是 DDRM 的一个特例。因此 ILVR 可以被进一步加速到 202020 步运行，但与 DDRM 不同，它没有处理测量噪声的明确途径。类似地，[22] 的作者提出了一种基于分数的逆问题求解器，能在少量迭代内收敛，但不处理测量中的噪声。

English original
ILVR [9] suggests a diffusion-based method that handles noiseless super-resolution, and can run in 250250250 steps. In Appendix H, we prove that when applied on the same underlying generative diffusion model, ILVR is a special case of DDRM. Therefore, ILVR can be further accelerated to run in 202020 steps, but unlike DDRM, it provides no clear way of handling noise in the measurements. Similarly, the authors of [22] suggest a score-based solver for inverse problems that can converge in a small number of iterations, but does not handle noise in the measurements.

5 实验

English original
5 Experiments

5.1 实验设置

English original
5.1 Experimental Setup

我们使用 [19] 中的扩散模型来展示算法的能力，这些模型分别在 CelebA-HQ [23]、LSUN 卧室与 LSUN 猫 [56] 上训练（均为 256×256256\times 256256×256 像素）。我们在 FFHQ [24] 的图像、以及来自互联网的相应 LSUN 类别图像上测试这些模型。此外，我们使用 [13] 中在 ImageNet 256×256256\times256256×256 与 512×512512\times512512×512 训练集上训练的模型，并在对应的验证集上测试。部分 ImageNet 模型需要类别信息；对这些模型我们以真实标签作为输入，并把算法记为 DDRM 类条件（DDRM-CC）。所有实验中我们取 η=0.85\eta=0.85η=0.85、ηb=1\eta_b=1ηb​=1，并基于 1000 步的预训练模型使用等距时间步安排（更多细节见附录 E）。每个实验中我们报告 NFE（时间步）的数量。

English original
We demonstrate our algorithm's capabilities using the diffusion models from [19], which are trained on CelebA-HQ [23], LSUN bedrooms, and LSUN cats [56] (all 256×256256 \times 256256×256 pixels). We test these models on images from FFHQ [24], and pictures from the internet of the considered LSUN category, respectively. In addition, we use the models from [13], trained on the training set of ImageNet 256×256256 \times 256256×256 and 512×512512 \times 512512×512, and tested on the corresponding validation set. Some of the ImageNet models require class information. For these models, we use the ground truth labels as input, and denote our algorithm as DDRM class conditional (DDRM-CC). In all experiments, we use η=0.85\eta = 0.85η=0.85, ηb=1\eta_b = 1ηb​=1, and a uniformly-spaced timestep schedule based on the 1000-step pre-trained models (more details in Appendix E). The number of NFEs (timesteps) is reported in each experiment.

在我们展示的每个逆问题中，像素值都位于 [0,1][0,1][0,1] 区间，退化测量按如下方式获得：(i) 超分辨率：用块平均滤波器在每一轴上把图像降采样 222、444 或 888 倍；(ii) 去模糊：用 9×99\times99×9 的均匀核模糊图像，并把低于某阈值的奇异值置零，使问题更病态；(iii) 上色：灰度图取原图红、绿、蓝三个通道的均值；(iv) 修补：用文字叠加遮挡原图的一部分，或随机丢弃 50%50\%50% 的像素。所有逆问题的测量都可以选择性地加入加性白高斯噪声。我们还在附录 I 中对双三次超分辨率与各向异性高斯核去模糊做了实验。我们的代码见 https://github.com/bahjat-kawar/ddrm。

English original
In each of the inverse problems we show, pixel values are in the range [0,1][0, 1][0,1], and the degraded measurements are obtained as follows: (i) for super-resolution, we use a block averaging filter to downscale the images by a factor of 222, 444, or 888 in each axis; (ii) for deblurring, the images are blurred by a 9×99 \times 99×9 uniform kernel, and singular values below a certain threshold are zeroed, making the problem more ill-posed. (iii) for colorization, the grayscale image is an average of the red, green, and blue channels of the original image; (iv) and for inpainting, we mask parts of the original image with text overlay or randomly drop 50%50\%50% of the pixels. Additive white Gaussian noise can optionally be added to the measurements in all inverse problems. We additionally conduct experiments on bicubic super-resolution and deblurring with an anisotropic Gaussian kernel in Appendix I. Our code is available at https://github.com/bahjat-kawar/ddrm.

5.2 定量实验

English original
5.2 Quantitative Experiments

为了量化 DDRM 的性能，我们聚焦于内容更多样的 ImageNet 数据集（256×256256\times256256×256）。每个实验中我们报告平均峰值信噪比（PSNR）与结构相似度指标（SSIM）[52] 以衡量对原图的保真度，以及乘以 10310^3103 的核 Inception 距离（KID）[5] 以衡量所得图像的质量。

English original
In order to quantify DDRM's performance, we focus on the ImageNet dataset (256×256256 \times 256256×256) for its diversity. For each experiment, we report the average peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and structural similarity index measure (SSIM) [52] to measure faithfulness to the original image, and the kernel Inception distance (KID) [5], multiplied by 10310^3103, to measure the resulting image quality.

我们把 DDRM（202020 步与 100100100 步）与其他能在合理时间内运行（需要 150015001500 次 NFE 或更少）且能在 ImageNet 上工作的无监督方法比较，即 RED [40]、DGP [38] 与 SNIPS [25]。各方法的具体设置见附录 F。对 DGP、RED 与 SNIPS，同一问题的含噪版本与无噪版本使用相同超参数，因为对每个版本单独调参会有损它们的无监督性质。尽管如此，像 RED 这样的基线即便这样调参，其性能也没有超过 DDRM，这一点我们在附录 F 中展示。此外，我们以双三次插值上采样作为超分辨率的基线，以模糊图本身作为去模糊的基线。OneNet [39] 未纳入比较，因为它限于 64×6464\times6464×64 的图像，推广到更高维需要改进的网络结构。

English original
We compare DDRM (with 202020 and 100100100 steps) with other unsupervised methods that work in reasonable time (requiring 150015001500 NFEs or less) and can operate on ImageNet. Namely, we compare with RED [40], DGP [38], and SNIPS [25]. The exact setup of each method is detailed in Appendix F. We used the same hyperparameters for noisy and noiseless versions of the same problem for DGP, RED, and SNIPS, as tuning them for each version would compromise their unsupervised nature. Nevertheless, the performance of baselines like RED with such a tuning does not surpass that of DDRM, as we show in Appendix F. In addition, we show upscaling by bicubic interpolation as a baseline for super-resolution, and the blurry image itself as a baseline for deblurring. OneNet [39] is not included in the comparisons as it is limited to images of size 64×6464 \times 6464×64, and generalization to higher dimensions requires an improved network architecture.

我们在 4×4\times4× 超分辨率与去模糊两个问题上评估所有方法，遵循 [38] 的做法，从 100010001000 个 ImageNet 类别各取一张验证集图像。表 1 显示 DDRM 在所有基线方法、所有指标、两个问题上都更优，且只用了 202020 步。唯一的例外是无噪去模糊中 SNIPS 的 KID 优于 DDRM，但它需要 50×50\times50× 更多的 NFE。注意所有被测方法的运行时间都与 NFE 严格线性相关，每次迭代的时间差异可忽略。DGP 与 DDRM-CC 使用测试图像的真实类别标签来辅助恢复过程，因此具有不公平的优势。

English original
We evaluate all methods on the problems of 4×4\times4× super-resolution and deblurring, on one validation set image from each of the 100010001000 ImageNet classes, following [38]. Table 1 shows that DDRM outperforms all baseline methods, in all metrics, and on both problems with only 202020 steps. The only exception to this is that SNIPS achieves better KID than DDRM in noiseless deblurring, but it requires 50×50\times50× more NFEs to do so. Note that the runtime of all the tested methods is perfectly linear with NFEs, with negligible differences in time per iteration. DGP and DDRM-CC use ground-truth class labels for the test images to aid in the restoration process, and thus have an unfair advantage.

当测量中加入显著噪声时，DDRM 相对于先前方法的吸引力变得更加明显。在这种设定下，DGP、RED 与 SNIPS 都未能给出可用的结果，这一点在表 2 与图 4 中清楚可见。由于 DDRM 很快，我们还在附录 F 中把它评估于整个 ImageNet 验证集。

English original
DDRM's appeal compared to previous methods becomes more substantial when significant noise is added to the measurements. Under this setting, DGP, RED, and SNIPS all fail to produce viable results, as evident in Table 2 and Figure 4. Since DDRM is fast, we also evaluate it on the entire ImageNet validation set in Appendix F.

5.3 定性实验

English original
5.3 Qualitative Experiments

DDRM 在所有被测数据集与问题上都能产生高质量的重建，见图 1、图 3 与附录 I。由于它是一种后验采样算法，DDRM 对同一输入可以产生多个输出，如图 5 所示。此外，无条件的 ImageNet 扩散模型可用于求解分布之外、内容一般的图像上的逆问题。在图 6 中，我们展示 DDRM 成功恢复了来自 USC-SIPI [53] 的 256×256256\times256256×256 图像，这些图像不一定属于任何 ImageNet 类别（更多结果见附录 I）。

English original
DDRM produces high quality reconstructions across all the tested datasets and problems, as can be seen in Figures 1 and 3, and in Appendix I. As it is a posterior sampling algorithm, DDRM can produce multiple outputs for the same input, as demonstrated in Figure 5. Moreover, the unconditional ImageNet diffusion models can be used to solve inverse problems on out-of-distribution images with general content. In Figure 6, we show DDRM successfully restoring 256×256256 \times 256256×256 images from USC-SIPI [53] that do not necessarily belong to any ImageNet class (more results in Appendix I).

6 结论

English original
6 Conclusions

我们提出了 DDRM：一个通用的、基于采样的线性逆问题求解器，它以无条件 / 类条件扩散生成模型作为学到的先验。受变分推断启发，与其他基于采样的基线（例如 SNIPS 需要 1000 次）相比，DDRM 只需很少的 NFE（例如 20 次），并在多个有用场景中具备可扩展性，包括去噪、超分辨率、去模糊、修补与上色。我们在各种问题与数据集上展示了 DDRM 的经验成功，包括位于所观测训练集分布之外的一般自然图像。据我们所知，DDRM 是第一个能够有效且高效地从含噪显著的逆问题后验中采样、并能处理一般内容自然图像的无监督方法。

English original
We have introduced DDRM, a general sampling-based linear inverse problem solver based on unconditional/class-conditional diffusion generative models as learned priors. Motivated by variational inference, DDRM only requires a few number of NFEs (e.g., 20) compared to other sampling-based baselines (e.g., 1000 for SNIPS) and achieves scalability in multiple useful scenarios, including denoising, super-resolution, deblurring, inpainting, and colorization. We demonstrate the empirical successes of DDRM on various problems and datasets, including general natural images outside the distribution of the observed training set. To our best knowledge, DDRM is the first unsupervised method that effectively and efficiently samples from the posterior distribution of inverse problems with significant noise, and can work on natural images with general content.

就未来工作而言，除了进一步优化时间步与方差安排，以下几个方向值得研究：(i) 把 DDRM 应用于非线性逆问题；(ii) 处理退化算子未知的情形；(iii) 受 DDRM 以及监督技术 [41] 中做法启发的自监督训练技术，以进一步提升无监督模型在图像恢复上的性能。

English original
In terms of future work, apart from further optimizing the timestep and variance schedules, it would be interesting to investigate the following: (i) applying DDRM to non-linear inverse problems, (ii) addressing scenarios where the degradation operator is unknown, and (iii) self-supervised training techniques inspired by DDRM as well as ones used in supervised techniques [41] that further improve performance of unsupervised models for image restoration.

D 省内存的 SVD

English original
D Memory Efficient SVD

这里我们解释如何为不同退化模型高效地得到其奇异值分解（SVD）。

English original
Here we explain how we obtained the singular value decomposition (SVD) for different degradation models efficiently.

D.1 去噪

English original
D.1 Denoising

在去噪中，受损图像是原图加上加性白高斯噪声。因此 H=IH=IH=I，HHH 的所有 SVD 元素就是单位矩阵 III，于是它们与任意向量相乘都变得平凡。

English original
In denoising, the corrupted image is the original image with additive white Gaussian noise. Therefore, H=IH = IH=I and all the SVD elements of HHH are simply the identity matrix III, which in turns makes their multiplication by different vectors trivial.

D.2 修补

English original
D.2 Inpainting

在修补中，HHH 保留图像像素中一个大小为 kkk 的已知子集。这等价于对像素做置换，把保留的像素放在前面，然后取前 kkk 个元素。因此

English original
In inpainting, HHH retains a known subset of size kkk of the image's pixels. This is equivalent to permuting the pixels such that the retained one are placed at the top, then keeping the first kkk entries. Therefore,
公式 (23)
H=I Σ P,\mathbf{H} = \mathbf{I}\,\mathbf{\Sigma}\,\mathbf{P},H=IΣP,
H = I Sigma P

其中 PPP 是相应的置换矩阵，Σ\SigmaΣ 是大小为 k×nk\times nk×n、主对角线上为 1 的矩形对角矩阵，III 是单位矩阵。由于置换矩阵是正交的，公式 (23)就是 HHH 的 SVD。

English original
where PPP is the appropriate permutation matrix, Σ\SigmaΣ is a rectangular diagonal matrix of size k×nk \times nk×n with ones in its main diagonal, and III is the identity matrix. Since permutation matrices are orthogonal, the equation above is the SVD of HHH.

我们可以只存储置换本身（而不存矩阵）来实现向量与 PPP、PTP^TPT 的相乘；Σ\SigmaΣ 与向量相乘只是切片。因此，只需存储相应置换与数目 kkk，我们就能以 Θ(n)\Theta(n)Θ(n) 的空间复杂度应用 SVD 的每个元素。

English original
We can multiply a given vector by PPP and PTP^TPT by storing the permutation itself rather than the matrix. Σ\SigmaΣ can multiply a vector by simply slicing it. Therefore, by storing the appropriate permutation and the number kkk, we can apply each element of the SVD with Θ(n)\Theta(n)Θ(n) space complexity.

D.3 超分辨率

English original
D.3 Super Resolution

对超分辨率，我们假设大小为 d×dd\times dd×d 的原图（即 n=3d2n=3d^2n=3d2）在每一维用块平均滤波器降采样 rrr 倍，且 ddd 能被 rrr 整除。此时输出图像中的每个像素是输入图像中一个 r×rr\times rr×r 补丁的平均，且每个补丁恰好影响一个输出像素。因此任一输出像素由 (Hx)i=kTpi(Hx)_i = k^T p_i(Hx)i​=kTpi​ 给出，其中 kkk 是长度为 r2r^2r2、每项为 1r2\frac{1}{r^2}r21​ 的向量，pip_ipi​ 是第 iii 个 r×rr\times rr×r 补丁的向量化形式。更形式化地，若 P1P_1P1​ 是把向量化图像重排为补丁的置换矩阵，则 H=(I⊗kT)P1H=\left(I\otimes k^T\right)P_1H=(I⊗kT)P1​，其中 ⊗\otimes⊗ 是 Kronecker 积，III 是大小为 dr×dr\frac{d}{r}\times\frac{d}{r}rd​×rd​ 的单位矩阵。为得到 HHH 的 SVD，我们计算 kTk^TkT 的 SVD：kT=UkΣkVkTk^T=U_k\Sigma_k V_k^TkT=Uk​Σk​VkT​。利用 Kronecker 积的性质，我们观察到

English original
For super resolution, we assume that the original image of size d×dd \times dd×d (i.e. n=3d2n = 3d^2n=3d2) is downscaled using a block averaging filter by rrr in each dimension, such that ddd is divisible by rrr. In this scenario, each pixel in the output image is the average of an r×rr \times rr×r patch in the input image, and each such patch affects exactly one output pixel. Therefore, any output pixel is given by (Hx)i=kTpi(Hx)_i = k^T p_i(Hx)i​=kTpi​, where kkk is a vector of size r2r^2r2 with 1/r21/r^21/r2 in each entry, and pip_ipi​ is the vectorized iii-th r×rr \times rr×r patch. More formally, if P1P_1P1​ is a permutation matrix that reorders a vectorized image into patches, then H=(I⊗kT)P1H = (I \otimes k^T)P_1H=(I⊗kT)P1​, where ⊗\otimes⊗ is the Kronecker product, and III is the identity matrix of size (d/r)×(d/r)(d/r) \times (d/r)(d/r)×(d/r). In order to obtain the SVD of HHH, we calculate the SVD of kTk^TkT: kT=UkΣkVkTk^T = U_k \Sigma_k V_k^TkT=Uk​Σk​VkT​. Using properties of the Kronecker product, we observe
公式 (24)
H=(I⊗kT)P1=((III)⊗(UkΣkVkT))P1=(I⊗Uk)(I⊗Σk)(I⊗VkT)P1.\begin{aligned} H &= \left(I \otimes k^T\right)P_1 = \left(\left(III\right)\otimes\left(U_k \Sigma_k V_k^T\right)\right)P_1 \\ &= \left(I \otimes U_k\right)\left(I \otimes \Sigma_k\right)\left(I \otimes V_k^T\right)P_1. \end{aligned}H​=(I⊗kT)P1​=((III)⊗(Uk​Σk​VkT​))P1​=(I⊗Uk​)(I⊗Σk​)(I⊗VkT​)P1​.​
H = (I kron U)(I kron Sigma)(I kron V^T)P

两个正交矩阵的 Kronecker 积仍是正交矩阵，因此 I⊗UkI\otimes U_kI⊗Uk​ 与 I⊗VkTI\otimes V_k^TI⊗VkT​ 正交。注意矩阵 I⊗ΣkI\otimes\Sigma_kI⊗Σk​ 的每一行只有一个非零值（1r2\frac{1}{r^2}r21​）；对其列做一次简单置换即可把这些值重排到主对角线上。记相应的置换矩阵为 P2P_2P2​，我们得到

English original
The Kronecker product of two orthogonal matrices is an orthogonal matrix. Therefore, I⊗UkI \otimes U_kI⊗Uk​ and I⊗VkTI \otimes V_k^TI⊗VkT​ are orthogonal. Observe that the matrix I⊗ΣkI \otimes \Sigma_kI⊗Σk​ has one non-zero value (1/r21/r^21/r2) in each row. By applying a simple permutation on its columns, these values can be reordered to be on the main diagonal. We denote the appropriate permutation matrix by P2P_2P2​, and obtain
公式 (25)
H=U Σ VT,\mathbf{H} = \mathbf{U}\,\mathbf{\Sigma}\,\mathbf{V}^{T},H=UΣVT,
H = U Sigma V^T

其中 U=I⊗UkU=I\otimes U_kU=I⊗Uk​ 正交，Σ=(I⊗Σk)P2T\Sigma=\left(I\otimes\Sigma_k\right)P_2^TΣ=(I⊗Σk​)P2T​ 是元素非负的矩形对角矩阵，VT=P2(I⊗VkT)P1V^T=P_2\left(I\otimes V_k^T\right)P_1VT=P2​(I⊗VkT​)P1​ 正交。因此公式 (25)就是 HHH 的 SVD。通过存储这些置换与 kTk^TkT 的 SVD 元素，我们可以在不显式计算与 III 的 Kronecker 积的情况下，以 Θ(n)\Theta(n)Θ(n) 的空间复杂度模拟 HHH 的 SVD 的每个元素。

English original
where U=I⊗UkU = I \otimes U_kU=I⊗Uk​ is orthogonal, Σ=(I⊗Σk)P2T\Sigma = (I \otimes \Sigma_k)P_2^TΣ=(I⊗Σk​)P2T​ is a rectangular diagonal matrix with non-negative entries, and VT=P2(I⊗VkT)P1V^T = P_2(I \otimes V_k^T)P_1VT=P2​(I⊗VkT​)P1​ is orthogonal. As such, the equation above is the SVD of HHH. By storing the permutations and the SVD elements of kTk^TkT, we can simulate each element of the SVD of HHH with Θ(n)\Theta(n)Θ(n) space complexity, without directly calculating the Kronecker products with III.

D.4 上色

English original
D.4 Colorization

灰度图由每个像素的红、绿、蓝通道取平均得到。这意味着每个输出像素由 (Hx)i=kTpi(Hx)_i=k^T p_i(Hx)i​=kTpi​ 给出，其中 kT=(13 13 13)k^T=\left(\frac{1}{3}\ \frac{1}{3}\ \frac{1}{3}\right)kT=(31​ 31​ 31​)，pip_ipi​ 是原彩色图像第 iii 个像素的三值向量。HHH 的 SVD 与超分辨率情形完全一样地得到，只是把「独立的补丁」换成「独立的像素」。

English original
The grayscale image is obtained by averaging the red, green, and blue channels of each pixel. This means that every output pixel is given by (Hx)i=kTpi(Hx)_i = k^T p_i(Hx)i​=kTpi​, where kT=(1/3  1/3  1/3)k^T = (1/3\ \ 1/3\ \ 1/3)kT=(1/3  1/3  1/3) and pip_ipi​ is the 3-valued iii-th pixel of the original color image. The SVD of HHH is obtained exactly the same as in the super resolution case, with separate pixels replacing separate patches.

D.5 去模糊

English original
D.5 Deblurring

我们关注可分离模糊，即 2D 模糊核为 K=rcTK=rc^TK=rcT，这意味着 ccc 作用在图像的列上、rTr^TrT 作用在其行上。模糊图像可由 B=AcXArTB=A_c X A_r^TB=Ac​XArT​ 得到，其中 AcA_cAc​ 与 ArA_rAr​ 分别用核 ccc 与 rrr 做 1D 卷积。等价地，b=Hxb=Hxb=Hx，其中 xxx 是向量化的图像 XXX，bbb 是向量化的模糊图像 BBB，HHH 是施加 2D 卷积 KKK 的矩阵。可以证明 H=Ar⊗AcH=A_r\otimes A_cH=Ar​⊗Ac​，其中 ⊗\otimes⊗ 是 Kronecker 积。为计算 HHH 的 SVD，我们计算 ArA_rAr​ 与 AcA_cAc​ 的 SVD：Ar=UrΣrVrTA_r=U_r\Sigma_r V_r^TAr​=Ur​Σr​VrT​、Ac=UcΣcVcTA_c=U_c\Sigma_c V_c^TAc​=Uc​Σc​VcT​。利用 Kronecker 积的性质，我们观察到

English original
We focus on separable blurring, where the 2D blurring kernel is K=rcTK = rc^TK=rcT, which means ccc is applied on the columns of the image, and rTr^TrT is applied on its rows. The blurred image can be obtained by B=AcXArTB = A_c X A_r^TB=Ac​XArT​, where AcA_cAc​ and ArA_rAr​ apply a 1D convolution with kernels ccc and rrr, respectively. Alternatively, b=Hxb = Hxb=Hx, where xxx is the vectorized image XXX, bbb is the vectorized blurred image BBB, and HHH is the matrix applying the 2D convolution KKK. It can be shown that H=Ar⊗AcH = A_r \otimes A_cH=Ar​⊗Ac​, where ⊗\otimes⊗ is the Kronecker product. In order to calculate the SVD of HHH, we calculate the SVD of ArA_rAr​ and AcA_cAc​: Ar=UrΣrVrTA_r = U_r \Sigma_r V_r^TAr​=Ur​Σr​VrT​, Ac=UcΣcVcTA_c = U_c \Sigma_c V_c^TAc​=Uc​Σc​VcT​. Using the properties of the Kronecker product, we observe
公式 (26)
H=Ar⊗Ac=(UrΣrVrT)⊗(UcΣcVcT)=(Ur⊗Uc)(Σr⊗Σc)(Vr⊗Vc)T.\begin{aligned} H &= A_r \otimes A_c = \left(U_r \Sigma_r V_r^T\right)\otimes\left(U_c \Sigma_c V_c^T\right) \\ &= \left(U_r \otimes U_c\right)\left(\Sigma_r \otimes \Sigma_c\right)\left(V_r \otimes V_c\right)^T. \end{aligned}H​=Ar​⊗Ac​=(Ur​Σr​VrT​)⊗(Uc​Σc​VcT​)=(Ur​⊗Uc​)(Σr​⊗Σc​)(Vr​⊗Vc​)T.​
H = (Ur kron Uc)(Sigmar kron Sigmac)(Vr kron Vc)^T

Kronecker 积保持正交性，因此公式 (26)是 HHH 的一个有效 SVD，只是奇异值不在主对角线上、也未按降序排列。我们重排各列使奇异值位于主对角线，并记相应的置换矩阵为 P1P_1P1​；再按降序排序，记排序置换矩阵为 P2P_2P2​，得到如下 SVD：

English original
The Kronecker product preserves orthogonality. Therefore, the equation above is a valid SVD of HHH, with the exception of the singular values not being on the main diagonal, and not being sorted descendingly. We reorder the columns so that the singular values are on the main diagonal and denote the corresponding permutation matrix by P1P_1P1​. We also sort the values descendingly and denote the sorting permutation matrix by P2P_2P2​, and obtain the following SVD:
公式 (27)
H=U Σ VT,\mathbf{H} = \mathbf{U}\,\mathbf{\Sigma}\,\mathbf{V}^{T},H=UΣVT,
H = U Sigma V^T

其中 U=(Ur⊗Uc)P2TU=\left(U_r\otimes U_c\right)P_2^TU=(Ur​⊗Uc​)P2T​，Σ=P2(Σr⊗Σc)P1TP2T\Sigma=P_2\left(\Sigma_r\otimes\Sigma_c\right)P_1^T P_2^TΣ=P2​(Σr​⊗Σc​)P1T​P2T​，VT=P2P1(Vr⊗Vc)TV^T=P_2 P_1\left(V_r\otimes V_c\right)^TVT=P2​P1​(Vr​⊗Vc​)T。

English original
where U=(Ur⊗Uc)P2TU = (U_r \otimes U_c)P_2^TU=(Ur​⊗Uc​)P2T​, Σ=P2(Σr⊗Σc)P1TP2T\Sigma = P_2(\Sigma_r \otimes \Sigma_c)P_1^T P_2^TΣ=P2​(Σr​⊗Σc​)P1T​P2T​, and VT=P2P1(Vr⊗Vc)TV^T = P_2 P_1(V_r \otimes V_c)^TVT=P2​P1​(Vr​⊗Vc​)T.

对任何形如 M=N⊗LM=N\otimes LM=N⊗L 的矩阵，都有 MxMxMx 是 LXNTLXN^TLXNT 的向量化形式。利用这一性质并施加相应的置换，我们就能在不存储完整矩阵的情况下模拟向量与 UUU、VVV、UTU^TUT 或 VTV^TVT 的相乘。该方法的空间复杂度为 Θ(n)\Theta(n)Θ(n)，用于计算 ArA_rAr​ 与 AcA_cAc​ 的 SVD 以及存储置换。

English original
For every matrix of the form M=N⊗LM = N \otimes LM=N⊗L, it holds that MxMxMx is the vectorized version of LXNTLX N^TLXNT. By using this property and applying the relevant permutation, we can simulate multiplying a vector by UUU, VVV, UTU^TUT, or VTV^TVT without storing the full matrix. The space complexity of this approach is Θ(n)\Theta(n)Θ(n), which is required for computing the SVD of ArA_rAr​ and AcA_cAc​, as well as storing the permutations.

当模糊采用零填充时（即图像被补零，使卷积在边缘处不是循环的），上述计算仍然有效；我们的实验使用的就是零填充去模糊。注意该问题的无噪版本有一个简单解——在模糊图像上施加模糊矩阵的伪逆。该解在 ImageNet-1K 上取得 32.4132.4132.41 dB 的 PSNR，而 DDRM 更进一步达到 35.6435.6435.64 dB。当模糊图像带有噪声时，这种简单解会放噪声，无法给出有效输出，因此我们选择不报告其结果。

English original
The above calculations remain valid when the blurring is zero-padded, i.e., images are padded with zeroes so that the convolution is not circulant around the edges. We consider a zero-padded deblurring problem in our experiments. Note that the noiseless version of this problem has a simple solution — applying the pseudo-inverse of the blurring matrix on the blurry image. This solution attains 32.4132.4132.41dB in PSNR on ImageNet-1K, while DDRM improves upon it and achieves 35.6435.6435.64dB. When noise is added to the blurry image, such a simple solution amplifies the noise and fails to provide a valid output. Therefore, we opt not to report its results.

此外，上述计算同样适用于带步长的卷积模糊。我们在双三次超分辨率 SVD 的实现中用了这一点，后者可以解释为使用固定核的带步长卷积。

English original
Furthermore, the above calculations are also applicable to blurring with strided convolutions. We use this fact in our implementation of the bicubic super resolution SVD, which can be interpreted as a strided convolution with a fixed kernel.

E 超参数的消融研究

English original
E Ablation Studies on Hyperparameters

η\etaη 与 ηb\eta_bηb​。　除时间步安排外，DDRM 还有两个超参数 η\etaη 与 ηb\eta_bηb​，控制每个时间步注入的噪声水平。为找出理想组合，我们在 σy=0.05\sigma_y=0.05σy​=0.05 的去模糊任务上、用 [13] 中训练的模型、在 100010001000 张 ImageNet 验证图像上对 η,ηb∈{0.7,0.8,0.9,1.0}\eta,\eta_b\in\{0.7,0.8,0.9,1.0\}η,ηb​∈{0.7,0.8,0.9,1.0} 做超参数搜索。也可以对 si=0s_i=0si​=0 的情形与 σi<σy/si\sigma_i<\sigma_y/s_iσi​<σy​/si​ 的情形取不同的 η\etaη；我们把这留作未来工作。我们在表 3 中报告 PSNR 与 KID 结果。

English original
η\etaη and ηb\eta_bηb​. Apart from the timestep schedules, DDRM has two hyperparameters η\etaη and ηb\eta_bηb​, which control the level of noise injected at each timestep. To identify an ideal combination, we perform a hyperparameter search over η,ηb∈{0.7,0.8,0.9,1.0}\eta, \eta_b \in \{0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0\}η,ηb​∈{0.7,0.8,0.9,1.0} for the task of deblurring with σy=0.05\sigma_y = 0.05σy​=0.05 in 100010001000 ImageNet validation images, using the model trained in [13]. It is possible to also consider different η\etaη values for si=0s_i = 0si​=0 and σi<σy/si\sigma_i < \sigma_y / s_iσi​<σy​/si​; we leave that as future work. We report PSNR and KID results in Table 3.

从结果中我们观察到，总体上 (i) 随着 ηb\eta_bηb​ 增大，PSNR 上升而 KID 下降，这很合理，因为我们希望利用 yyy 的信息；(ii) 随着 η\etaη 增大，PSNR 上升（η=1.0\eta=1.0η=1.0 除外），但 KID 也随之上升，这体现了重建误差与图像质量之间的权衡（即感知—失真权衡 [6]）。因此，在报告结果时我们选择 ηb=1\eta_b=1ηb​=1、η=0.85\eta=0.85η=0.85，以平衡 PSNR 与 KID 的表现。

English original
From the results, we observe that generally (i) as ηb\eta_bηb​ increases, PSNR increases while KID decreases, which is reasonable given that we wish to leverage the information from yyy; (ii) as η\etaη increases, PSNR increases (except for η=1.0\eta = 1.0η=1.0) yet KID also increases, which presents a trade-off in reconstruction error and image quality (known as the perception-distortion trade-off [6]). Therefore, we choose ηb=1\eta_b = 1ηb​=1 and η=0.85\eta = 0.85η=0.85 to balance performance on PSNR and KID when we report results.

时间步安排。　时间步安排直接影响 NFE，因为实际耗时大致与 NFE 成正比 [45]。在表 5 与表 6 中，我们比较了 DDRM 在 202020 步或 100100100 步（有或无类别条件）以及默认 η=0.85\eta=0.85η=0.85、ηb=1\eta_b=1ηb​=1 下的 PSNR、FID 与 KID。我们观察到，在其他超参数相同时，202020 步与 100100100 步的 DDRM 表现相近，其中 DDRM（20）在 FID 与 KID 上略有优势。

English original
Timestep schedules. The timestep schedule has a direct impact on NFEs, as the wall-clock time is roughly linear with respect to NFEs [45]. In Tables 5 and 6, we compare the PSNR, FID, and KID of DDRM with 20 or 100 timesteps (with or without conditioning) and default η=0.85\eta = 0.85η=0.85 and ηb=1\eta_b = 1ηb​=1. We observe that DDRM with 20 or 100 timesteps have similar performance when other hyperparameters are identical, with DDRM (20) having a slight edge in FID and KID.

F DGP、RED 与 SNIPS 的实验设置

English original
F Experimental Setup of DGP, RED, and SNIPS

回顾一下，我们在 256×256256\times256256×256 的 ImageNet 1K 图像上、对测量不含任何噪声的 4×4\times4× 超分辨率与去模糊两个问题评估了 DGP [38]、RED [40] 与 SNIPS [25]。下面我们展开每个方法的实验设置。

English original
Recall that we evaluated DGP [38], RED [40], and SNIPS [25] on 256×256256\times256256×256 ImageNet 1K images, for the problems of 4×4\times4× super resolution and deblurring without any noise in the measurements. Below we expand on the experimental setup of each one.

对 DGP [38]，我们使用原论文为「偏向 MSE 的超分辨率」引入的相同超参数。我们注意到 DGP 使用的降采样与我们使用的块平均滤波器不同，且他们报告的数值是在 128×128128\times128128×128 分辨率上的。尽管如此，在我们的实验中，DGP 在 ImageNet 1K 256×256256\times256256×256 块平均 4×4\times4× 超分辨率上取得 23.0623.0623.06 的 PSNR，与原工作报告的 23.3023.3023.30 相近。应用到去模糊问题时，我们也沿用相同的 DGP 超参数。

English original
For DGP [38], we use the same hyperparameters introduced in the original paper for MSE-biased super resolution. We note that the downscaling applied in DGP is different from the block averaging filter that we used, and the numbers they reported are on the 128×128128\times128128×128 resolution. Nevertheless, in our experiments, DGP achieved a PSNR of 23.0623.0623.06 on ImageNet 1K 256×256256\times256256×256 block averaging 4×4\times4× super resolution, which is similar to the 23.3023.3023.30 reported in the original work. When applied on the deblurring problem, we retained the same DGP hyperparameters as well.

对 RED [40]，我们只在 YCbCr 空间的亮度通道上运行迭代算法，这与原论文在去模糊与超分辨率上的做法一致。至于驱动该算法的去噪引擎，我们使用与 DDRM 相同的扩散模型，以尽可能做到公平比较。我们使用扩散模型的最后一步（等价于以 σ=0.005\sigma=0.005σ=0.005 去噪），因为经验上它表现最好。我们还选择了最速下降版本（RED-SD），并针对所用去噪器取 λ=500\lambda=500λ=500 以获得最佳 PSNR。当测量无噪时我们取 σ0=0.01\sigma_0=0.01σ0​=0.01，因为 RED 会除以 σ0\sigma_0σ0​，故其不能为 000。

English original
For RED [40], we apply the iterative algorithm only in the luminance channel of the image in the YCbCr space, as done in the original paper for deblurring and super resolution. As for the denoising engine enabling the algorithm, we use the same diffusion model used in DDRM to enable as fair a comparison as possible. We use the last step of the diffusion model (equivalent to denoising with σ=0.005\sigma = 0.005σ=0.005), as we found it to work best empirically. We also chose the steepest-descent version (RED-SD), and λ=500\lambda = 500λ=500 for best PSNR performance given the denoiser we used. We also set σ0=0.01\sigma_0 = 0.01σ0​=0.01 when the measurements are noiseless, because σ0\sigma_0σ0​ cannot be 000 as RED divides by it.

在超分辨率中，RED 以双三次上采样的低分辨率图像初始化；在去模糊中，以模糊图像初始化。随后我们在 ImageNet 1K 上以不同步数运行 RED（见表 4），并为每个问题选择最佳 PSNR。也就是说，正文中我们展示的是超分辨率 100100100 步、去模糊 500500500 步的 RED。有趣的是，RED 在超分辨率上仅用 202020 步就接近其最佳 PSNR。然而 DDRM（202020 步）在 PSNR 上仍优于 RED，并且感知质量明显更好（见正文表 1）。

English original
In super resolution, RED is initialized with the bicubic upsampled low-res image. In deblurring, it is initialized with the blurry image. We then run RED on the ImageNet 1K for different numbers of steps (see Table 4), and choose the best PSNR for each problem. Namely, we show in our paper RED on super resolution with 100100100 steps, and on deblurring with 500500500 steps. Interestingly, RED achieves a PSNR close to its best for super resolution in just 202020 steps. However, DDRM (with 202020 steps) still outperforms RED in PSNR, with substantially better perceptual quality (see Table 1 in the main paper).

另一个有趣的即插即用图像恢复方法是 DPIR [57]，它近来取得了令人印象深刻的结果：借助新提出的网络结构实施著名的半二次分裂（HQS）即插即用算法。HQS 需要求解一个最小化问题的解析解，而这在一般情况下由于内存需求过高而不可行。DPIR 针对所考虑的特定退化矩阵 HHH（循环模糊、双三次降采样）给出了高效解，这些与我们考虑的（零填充模糊、块降采样）不同。为公平比较两种算法，需要在两者中使用相同的去噪器结构（如我们对 RED 与 SNIPS 所做的那样），并使用相同的退化模型。若要把 DPIR 应用到我们考虑的问题上，需要大幅修改它并引入高效解。因此，我们改为与另一种即插即用方法 RED 比较。

English original
Another interesting plug-and-play image restoration method is DPIR [57], which has recently achieved impressive results. It does so by applying the well-known Half Quadratic Splitting (HQS) plug-and-play algorithm using a newly proposed architecture. HQS requires an analytical solution of a minimization problem which is infeasible in general, due to the high memory requirements. DPIR provides efficient solutions for the specific degradation matrices HHH considered (circulant blurring, bicubic downsampling), which are different from the ones we consider (zero-padded blurring, block downsampling). In order to draw a fair comparison between the algorithms, one would have to use the same denoiser architecture in both (as we have done for RED and SNIPS), and use the same degradation models. To apply DPIR on the same problems that we consider, we would need to substantially modify it and introduce efficient solutions. Therefore, we instead compare to RED, an alternative plug-and-play method.

SNIPS [25] 最初并不支持 ImageNet 图像。但考虑到该方法与 DDRM 的相似性（两者都在 HHH 的谱空间中工作），比较是必要的。为公平起见，我们对 SNIPS 使用与 DDRM 相同的底层扩散模型（全部 100010001000 个时间步）。SNIPS 在每个时间步对扩散模型求值 τ\tauτ 次。我们取 τ=1\tau=1τ=1，以使 SNIPS 的运行时间相对其他方法保持合理，未探索更大的 τ\tauτ。值得一提的是，原工作中 τ\tauτ 被设为 333，用于一个 108610861086 步的 LSUN 卧室扩散模型。我们取 c=0.67c=0.67c=0.67，因为它取得最佳 PSNR。

English original
SNIPS [25] did not originally work with ImageNet images. However, considering the method's similarity to DDRM (as both operate in the spectral space of HHH), a comparison is necessary. We apply SNIPS with the same underlying diffusion model (with all 100010001000 timesteps) as DDRM for fairness. SNIPS evaluates the diffusion model τ\tauτ times for each timestep. We set τ=1\tau = 1τ=1 so that SNIPS' runtime remains reasonable in comparison to the rest of the considered methods, and do not explore higher values of τ\tauτ. It is worth mentioning that in the original work, τ\tauτ was set to 333 for an LSUN bedrooms diffusion model with 108610861086 timesteps. We set c=0.67c = 0.67c=0.67 as it achieved the best PSNR performance.

SNIPS 的原工作直接计算 HHH 的 SVD，这使其难以在常见硬件上处理 256×256256\times256256×256 图像。为便于比较，我们把直接计算 SVD 替换为附录 D 中详述的高效实现。

English original
The original work in SNIPS calculates the SVD of HHH directly, which hinders its ability to handle 256×256256 \times 256256×256 images on typical hardware. In order to draw comparisons, we replaced the direct calculation of the SVD with our efficient implementation detailed in Appendix D.

在正文图 4 与表 2 中，我们展示当测量中加入显著噪声时，DGP、RED 与 SNIPS 都未能给出可用结果。对这些结果，所有算法都使用无噪情形下的同一组超参数（除适用处的 σy\sigma_yσy​ 外）。调参或许能提升性能，但我们不探索该选项，因为我们只关心那些在给定 HHH 与 σy\sigma_yσy​ 后恢复过程自动完成的算法。为进一步展示 DDRM 的能力与速度，我们在表 5 与表 6 中于全部 50,00050{,}00050,000 张 ImageNet 验证集上评估它，并在样本量足够时报告 Fréchet Inception 距离（FID）[18] 与 KID。

English original
In Figure 4 and Table 2 in the main paper, we show that DGP, RED, and SNIPS all fail to produce viable results when significant noise is added to the measurements. For these results, we use the same hyperparameters used in the noiseless case for all algorithms (except σy\sigma_yσy​ where applicable). While tuning the hyperparameters may boost performance, we do not explore that option as we are only interested in algorithms where given HHH and σy\sigma_yσy​, the restoration process is automatic. To further demonstrate DDRM's capabilities and speed, we evaluate it on the entire 50,00050{,}00050,000-image ImageNet validation set in Tables 5 and 6, reporting Fréchet Inception distance (FID) [18] as well as KID, as enough samples are available.

G 算法的运行时间

English original
G Runtime of Algorithms

正文中我们用神经网络函数求值次数（NFE）作为算法运行时间的代理。这里我们考虑含噪去模糊的情形，在 Nvidia RTX 3080 GPU 上测量 DDRM、RED、SNIPS 与 DGP 的运行时间。对每张图像，DDRM、RED 与 SNIPS 都约为 0.090.090.09 秒/迭代，差异可忽略（<0.01<0.01<0.01 秒/迭代）。注意 DDRM、SNIPS 与 RED 的去噪器模型相同，因此运行时间几乎与 NFE 完美线性相关。DGP 使用不同的模型（GAN），比我们的去噪器稍慢（0.110.110.11 秒/迭代）；部分原因是 DGP 为执行更新需要额外的梯度计算。总之，我们观察到运行时间确实与 NFE 线性相关，且没有任何算法具有显著的运行时间优势，因此我们倾向于用 NFE 作为运行时间的代理，因为它是与硬件无关的指标。

English original
In the main paper, we show the number of neural function evaluations (NFEs) as a proxy for the runtime of algorithms. Here, we consider the case of noisy deblurring, and measure the runtime of DDRM, RED, SNIPS, and DGP on an Nvidia RTX 3080 GPU. For each image, DDRM, RED, and SNIPS all run at around 0.090.090.09 s/it (seconds per iteration), with negligible differences of <0.01<0.01<0.01s/it. We note that the denoiser model of DDRM, SNIPS, and RED is the same, so runtime is almost perfectly linearly correlated with NFEs. As for DGP, it uses a different model (a GAN), and it is slightly slower than our denoiser (0.110.110.11 s/it); this is partly because DGP requires additional gradient computations in order to perform an update. All in all, we observe that the runtime is indeed linear with NFEs, and since no algorithm has a significant runtime advantage over the rest, we prefer to use NFEs as a proxy for runtime, as it is a hardware-independent measure.

本文使用预训练的生成模型做图像恢复。由于我们没有训练任何模型，单块 Nvidia RTX 3080 GPU 就足以运行论文与附录中展示的全部实验。

English original
In this paper, we used pretrained generative models for image restoration. Since we didn't train any models, a single Nvidia RTX 3080 GPU was sufficient to run all experiments that were shown in the paper and the appendices.

至于 xTx_TxT​，ILVR 从 N(0,σT2I)\mathcal{N}(0,\sigma_T^2 I)N(0,σT2​I)（方差保持情形下为 N(0,I)\mathcal{N}(0,I)N(0,I)）采样初始化，而 DDRM 按正文公式 (7)采样。两种初始化方差相同、均值不同。由于方差远大于均值之差，这一差异对最终结果的影响可忽略。因此，上述形式的 ILVR 是 DDRM 的一个具体形式（取 η=ηb=1\eta=\eta_b=1η=ηb​=1），可作为无测量噪声的线性逆问题的解。

English original
As for xTx_TxT​, ILVR initializes it by sampling from N(0,σT2I)\mathcal{N}(0, \sigma_T^2 I)N(0,σT2​I) (or N(0,I)\mathcal{N}(0, I)N(0,I) in the variance preserving case) while DDRM samples according to Equation 7 in the main paper. The two initializations have the same variance but differ in the mean. This difference has a negligible effect on the end result since the variance is much larger than the difference in the means. Therefore, the above form of ILVR is a specific form of a DDRM (with η=ηb=1\eta = \eta_b = 1η=ηb​=1), posed as a solution for linear inverse problems without noise in the measurements.

在其实验中，ILVR 只测试了不同缩放因子下的双三次降采样矩阵 HHH。理论上，只要 yyy 不含噪声，ILVR 也可用于任意线性退化 HHH。

English original
In their experiments, ILVR only tested HHH which is the bicubic downscaling matrix with varying scale factors. In theory, ILVR can also work for any linear degradation HHH, as long as yyy does not contain noise.

I 补充结果

English original
I Additional Results

我们在下面给出补充图，展示 DDRM 在不同数据集、不同逆问题与不同噪声水平下的多面性（图 7、图 8、图 10、图 11 与图 12）。我们还在图 9 中展示 DDRM 提供的样本多样性；并在图 13 与图 14 中给出更多来自 ImageNet 实验的未筛选样本。此外，我们通过在两个额外的逆问题上评估，进一步说明 DDRM 相对先前无监督方法的优势：(i) 使用流行的双三次降采样核的 4×4\times4× 超分辨率；(ii) 使用各向异性高斯模糊核的去模糊（水平 σ=20\sigma=20σ=20、垂直 σ=1\sigma=1σ=1），模拟运动模糊。我们在表 7 与表 8 中分别给出无噪与含噪版本。为保持被测方法的无监督性质，我们使用与块平均超分辨率和均匀去模糊相同的超参数。

English original
We provide additional figures below showing DDRM's versatility across different datasets, inverse problems, and noise levels (Figures 7, 8, 10, 11, and 12). We also showcase the sample diversity provided by DDRM in Figure 9; we present more uncurated samples from the ImageNet experiments in Figures 13 and 14. Moreover, we further illustrate DDRM's advantage over previous unsupervised methods by evaluating on two additional inverse problems: (i) 4×4\times4× super-resolution with the popular bicubic downsampling kernel; and (ii) deblurring with an anisotropic Gaussian blur kernel (with σ=20\sigma=20σ=20 horizontally and σ=1\sigma=1σ=1 vertically), mimicing motion blur. We show both noiseless and noisy versions in Tables 7 and 8, respectively. To maintain the unsupervised nature of the tested methods, we use the same hyperparameters as in block-averaging super-resolution and uniform deblurring.
